name: Top Hosts by Traffic
sql: SELECT IPv4NumToString(IPV4_ADDR) IPV4_ADDR_FORMATTED, IPv6NumToString(IPV6_ADDR) IPV6_ADDR_FORMATTED, HOST_LABEL, SUM(BYTES) total_bytes FROM (SELECT IPV4_SRC_ADDR IPV4_ADDR, IPV6_SRC_ADDR IPV6_ADDR, SRC_LABEL HOST_LABEL, TOTAL_BYTES BYTES $FROM$ $WHERE$ UNION ALL SELECT IPV4_DST_ADDR IPV4_ADDR, IPV6_DST_ADDR IPV6_ADDR, DST_LABEL HOST_LABEL, TOTAL_BYTES BYTES $FROM$ $WHERE$) AS f $GROUPBY$ $ORDERBY$ $LIMIT$
